The compromise began with a malicious PowerShell execution likely delivered via phishing (T1566.001), leading to execution of an unsigned DLL via rundll32 (T1218.011).     category: dns_query
    product: network_sensor
detection:
    selection:
        query_type: TXT
        subdomain_entropy|float > 3.8
    c2_domain_match:
        query: "*.exfil-c2.example.com"
    condition: selection or c2_domain_match
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate high-entropy domains (e.g., CDNs, encryption services)
level: high

title: DNS Tunneling via High-Entropy TXT Queries to Known C2 Domain
